assertions.assertion: The payer that issued the denial is Blue Summit
CPT 93271 corresponds to cardiac event monitoring
The denial was issued under reason code PR-204
The stated denial rationale is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The denial letter directs the appellant to detail the clinical necessity
The patient presents with a history of intermittent palpitations
The patient has subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats
The symptoms prompted further evaluation for suspected cardiac arrhythmia
The submitted diagnosis codes are I49.9 and R00.2
The diagnosis codes I49.9 and R00.2 are consistent with the clinical indication note's findings
The cardiac event monitoring study was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances
The study captures electrocardiographic data during symptom onset
